import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

# --- Perceive nut and peg ---
nut_center_pos, nut_center_quat = get_object_pose("white hollow center of the brown square nut")
peg_pos, peg_quat = get_object_pose("brown square block")

# --- Sample grasp on the handle ---
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = sample_grasp_pose("extruded handle of the brown square nut")

# --- Compute fixed rigid transform between nut center and grasp (in nut frame) ---
R_nut = R.from_quat([nut_center_quat[1], nut_center_quat[2], nut_center_quat[3], nut_center_quat[0]])
R_grasp = R.from_quat([grasp_quat[1], grasp_quat[2], grasp_quat[3], grasp_quat[0]])
# offset from nut center to grasp, expressed in nut frame
offset_nut = R_nut.inv().apply(grasp_pos - nut_center_pos)
# relative rotation: grasp = nut * rel
R_rel = R_nut.inv() * R_grasp

# --- Grasp the nut ---
goto_home_joint_position()
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# --- Lift ---
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# --- Target nut center pose: above peg, keep nut's current orientation (yaw unchanged, already square-aligned by grasp) ---
# Keep nut orientation the same as at grasp time to avoid twisting; place nut center at peg xy, hovering above.
R_nut_target = R_nut
target_center_pos = np.array([peg_pos[0], peg_pos[1], nut_center_pos[2] + 0.12])
ee_pos_hover = target_center_pos + R_nut_target.apply(offset_nut)
R_ee_target = R_nut_target * R_rel
q_xyzw = R_ee_target.as_quat()
ee_quat_target = np.array([q_xyzw[3], q_xyzw[0], q_xyzw[1], q_xyzw[2]])

goto_pose(ee_pos_hover, ee_quat_target)

# --- Insert: lower the nut center down onto the peg ---
insert_center_pos = np.array([peg_pos[0], peg_pos[1], peg_pos[2]])
ee_pos_insert = insert_center_pos + R_nut_target.apply(offset_nut)
goto_pose(ee_pos_insert, ee_quat_target, z_approach=0.08)

# --- Release and retreat ---
open_gripper()
retreat_pos = ee_pos_insert.copy()
retreat_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(retreat_pos, ee_quat_target)
goto_home_joint_position()
